augBlueprint.name: AUTO_COOLDOWN
augBlueprint.title: Automated Re-loader
augBlueprint.desc: Weapon charge speed rises 10% per copy. Charge time is divided by 1 + copies / 10.

augBlueprint.name: EXPLOSIVE_REPLICATOR
augBlueprint.title: Explosive Replicator
augBlueprint.desc: A missile has a 50% chance not to be spent.

augBlueprint.name: CLOAK_FIRE
augBlueprint.title: Stealth Weapons
augBlueprint.desc: Firing does not drop cloaking.

augBlueprint.name: WEAPON_PREIGNITE
augBlueprint.title: Weapon Pre-Igniter
augBlueprint.desc: After a jump, enabled weapons that have power start fully charged.

augBlueprint.name: REPAIR_ARM
augBlueprint.title: Repair Arm
augBlueprint.desc: Scrap gain repairs 2 hull and is cut 15% while the hull is not already full.

augBlueprint.name: ION_ARMOR
augBlueprint.title: Reverse Ion Field
augBlueprint.desc: 50% chance to ignore an ion hit. Two or more ignore every ion hit.

augBlueprint.name: SHIELD_RECHARGE
augBlueprint.title: Shield Charge Booster
augBlueprint.desc: Shields recharge 15% faster per copy.

augBlueprint.name: FTL_BOOSTER
augBlueprint.title: FTL Recharge Booster
augBlueprint.desc: One copy makes FTL charge take 80% as long. Two take 67%. Three take 57%.

augBlueprint.name: SCRAP_COLLECTOR
augBlueprint.title: Scrap Recovery Arm
augBlueprint.desc: Scrap gain is 10% higher per copy, applied before a weld cut, then rounded down.

augBlueprint.name: ROCK_ARMOR
augBlueprint.title: Rock Plating
augBlueprint.desc: 15% chance to ignore hull damage. Systems still take the hit. Not a store item on the wiki; 50 scrap is invented.

augBlueprint.name: SYSTEM_CASING
augBlueprint.title: Titanium System Casing
augBlueprint.desc: 15% chance to ignore system damage. The hull still takes the hit. Not a store item on the wiki; 50 scrap is invented.

augBlueprint.name: BATTERY_BOOSTER
augBlueprint.title: Battery Charger
augBlueprint.desc: The Backup Battery cooldown is cut in half.

augBlueprint.name: O2_MASKS
augBlueprint.title: Emergency Respirators
augBlueprint.desc: Suffocation damage is halved, including while boarding. A Crystal takes a quarter.

augBlueprint.name: FIRE_EXTINGUISHERS
augBlueprint.title: Fire Suppression
augBlueprint.desc: Fires on your ship die down faster than a person can put them out.

augBlueprint.name: FLEET_DISTRACTION
augBlueprint.title: Distraction Buoys
augBlueprint.desc: At sector start, before sector 8, the fleet falls back one jump.

augBlueprint.name: ADV_SCANNERS
augBlueprint.title: Long-Ranged Scanners
augBlueprint.desc: Adjacent beacons show an environmental hazard and possible ship presence. Selling or swapping the scanners hides that again.

augBlueprint.name: FTL_JAMMER
augBlueprint.title: FTL Jammer
augBlueprint.desc: Enemy ships take twice as long to charge FTL.

augBlueprint.name: DRONE_RECOVERY
augBlueprint.title: Drone Recovery Arm
augBlueprint.desc: A powered defense drone gives its part back when the jump starts. A powered combat drone gives it back only after the fight. Boarding, ion, crew, and hacking drones do not.

augBlueprint.name: HACKING_STUN
augBlueprint.title: Hacking Stun
augBlueprint.desc: Everyone in a room during a hacking pulse is stunned for that pulse.

augBlueprint.name: BACKUP_DNA
augBlueprint.title: Backup DNA Bank
augBlueprint.desc: A waiting body stays in the clone bay queue even when the clone bay is off or broken.

augBlueprint.name: TELEPORT_HEAL
augBlueprint.title: Reconstructive Teleport
augBlueprint.desc: A person sent through the teleporter is fully healed.

augBlueprint.name: LIFE_SCANNER
augBlueprint.title: Lifeform Scanner
augBlueprint.desc: Living crew show up even when sensors do not.

augBlueprint.name: FTL_JUMPER
augBlueprint.title: Adv. FTL Navigation
augBlueprint.desc: The ship can jump to any previously visited beacon, including beacons later overtaken by the Rebel Fleet.

augBlueprint.name: DEFENSE_SCRAMBLER
augBlueprint.title: Defense Scrambler
augBlueprint.desc: Enemy Defense Drone I, Defense Drone II, and Anti-Combat drones cannot acquire or shoot down targets. Your own defense drones still fire.

augBlueprint.name: ZOLTAN_BYPASS
augBlueprint.title: Zoltan Shield Bypass
augBlueprint.desc: Crew teleportation, bomb teleportation, and mind control work through Zoltan Shields.
